integrity: The logarithmic lower regime is obtained from the anchor paper's explicit pre-specialization Remez lower bound and independently re-derived endpoint asymptotics. Endpoint triviality is proved directly in the anchor paper's diamond-norm success metric. Numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The critical constant-scale regime alpha=1 is not classified.
The result does not prove the full uniform-in-t conjectured complexity law.
Near t=1 the endpoint-trivial statement is only that one query suffices, not that one query is always necessary.
title: A critical endpoint exponent for fractional-unitary query complexity
